description: 한국환경공단_도로 재비산먼지 합성데이터 정보 조회 서비스 [roads, bridges and tunnels] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 한국환경공단. 도로 재비산먼지 및 배경먼지 측정 합성데이터는 특수제작한 이동측정차량으로 주행하는 차량의 타이어(휠)와 도로면의 마찰에 의해서 재비산되는 먼지(PM10)과 도로 주변 대기의 먼지(PM10. Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 한국환경공단. Its tags are 도로, 재비산, 도로청소, 측정정보, 대기관리권역. It offers 1 resource(s) in xml. The portal shows 2025-12-12 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
